tagline: Beaches, Portuguese heritage, seafood and nightlife on India's west coast
signatureFood: fish thali, prawn balchao, bebinca, pork vindaloo, poi bread

seasons.label: Peak season
seasons.note: Dry, sunny and busy; water sports and nightlife are at their best. Book stays early.

seasons.label: Hot and humid
seasons.note: Hot, humid afternoons; beach time works best early morning and late afternoon.

seasons.label: Monsoon
seasons.note: Heavy rain; water sports and many beach shacks shut, rough sea, but waterfalls are at full flow.

places.name: Baga and Calangute Beach
places.desc: Goa's busiest beach strip, with shacks, sunbeds and a lively evening scene.

places.name: Water Sports at Baga
places.desc: Package of jet ski, banana boat ride and parasailing from licensed operators on Baga beach; closed in monsoon.

places.name: Fort Aguada and Lighthouse
places.desc: 17th-century Portuguese sea fort with a four-storey lighthouse and views of the Arabian Sea.

places.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral
places.desc: UNESCO-listed Baroque churches in Old Goa, including the tomb of St Francis Xavier.

places.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Walk
places.desc: Narrow lanes of colourful Portuguese-era houses, chapels and cafes in Panjim.

places.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls Jeep Safari
places.desc: Jeep ride through Mollem forest to the four-tier Dudhsagar falls; usually closed in peak monsoon.

places.name: Chapora Fort Sunset
places.desc: Ruined Portuguese fort above Vagator beach with some of north Goa's best sunset views.

places.name: Palolem Beach
places.desc: Crescent-shaped, calmer beach in south Goa with kayaking and a relaxed vibe; a long drive from north Goa.

places.name: Mandovi River Sunset Cruise
places.desc: Evening boat cruise on the Mandovi with Goan folk dance and live music.

places.name: Tito's Lane Nightlife
places.desc: Goa's best-known party street with clubs, bars and DJ nights; cover and drinks add up.

places.name: Goan Seafood Lunch in Panjim
places.desc: Classic fish-thali lunch at a local Panjim restaurant, with xacuti, recheado fry and sol kadhi.

places.name: Spice Plantation Tour
places.desc: Guided walk through a working spice farm with a traditional Goan lunch included.
